svg.title: kafka logback append sequence
svg.desc: KafkaAppender drains deferred Kafka client logs, encodes normal events, builds a Kafka record, sends asynchronously through KafkaExporter, and routes failures to fallback appenders.
svg.text: Normal events send asynchronously; Kafka client logs are deferred.
ProducerRecord: topic, partition, timestamp, key, value
stop() drains deferred logs, flushes the producer, closes it, and then stops the appender.
